1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder __that is a solder paste__; and a solvent.

9. (Currently amended) A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder __that is a solder paste__, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

10. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

11. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is __a__ premixed solder paste.

13. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __greater than 12 μm and less than 30 μm__ in size.
